template_description: Template for working_memory.json - hierarchical workflow with dual-mode support
template_notes: Version 3.0 adds hierarchical phase tracking, development mode (rigid/flexible), iteration budgets, architecture anchor, and resync protocol support

paths.note: CRITICAL: These paths MUST be read and used for ALL tool/template/workflow references. Set during Setup workflow (00a-basic_setup). LLM agents: ALWAYS extract these paths from working_memory.json before invoking tools.

phase_tracking.note: Hierarchical phase tracking. Phases: P0 (Setup), P1 (Functional Analysis), P2 (Architecture), P3 (Development), P4 (Validation), P5 (Operations), PM (Meta)

development_mode.note: CRITICAL: Set during P0. 'flexible' = architecture evolves with implementation (personal/exploratory). 'rigid' = implementation must conform to architecture (enterprise/approved).

iteration_tracking.note: Tracks P3<->P4 iterations. When current_count >= budget, resync_protocol is triggered to force architecture review.

architecture_anchor.note: Created when transitioning P2->P3. Re-injected at phase transitions and periodically during development. Prevents architecture drift.

discovered_items.note: Track new requirements discovered during P3/P4. Flexible mode: discovered_requirements. Rigid mode: change_requests.

user_preferences.stakeholder_approval_rationale: REASON_WHY_APPROVAL_IS_OR_ISNT_NEEDED (e.g., 'Personal project' or 'Enterprise system requiring formal review')
user_preferences.note: Set during Setup workflow - determines if formal stakeholder approval steps are mandatory or can be skipped. null = not yet asked, true = formal approval required, false = skip approval steps (personal/hobby projects)

framework_configuration.selected_framework_rationale: DETAILED_RATIONALE_WHY_THIS_FRAMEWORK_WAS_CHOSEN (must explain semantic match and what insights it reveals)
framework_configuration.note: Set during Setup workflow step S-01A (Framework Selection) - REQUIRES EXPLICIT USER CONFIRMATION per LESSON-01

system_characteristics.cycles_expected: YES|NO - Are cycles feedback loops (expected) or circular dependencies (errors)?

framework_analysis.note: Populated during S-01A framework selection analysis - documents WHICH frameworks were considered and WHY others were rejected

analysis_configuration.note: Set during Systems Engineering workflow step SE-06 (Graph Generation)

llm_capabilities.note: v3.9.1 - Auto-detect LLM context window at workflow start/resume. Run: python3 {paths.tools_path}/detect_llm_capabilities.py --interactive --update-working-memory {paths.system_root}

context_flow_analysis.note: v3.9.0 - Predictive context management via flow analysis. v3.9.1: Threshold auto-set from llm_capabilities

notes: v3.9.1: FIRST ACTION when starting/resuming workflow: Detect LLM capabilities (see llm_capabilities.note)
Increment operations_since_refresh after each real operation (see context_management_template.json)
When operations_since_refresh >= 5, execute context refresh sequence
When degradation signal detected, execute refresh immediately regardless of counter
v3.9.0: When context_flow_analysis.refresh_recommended is true, execute refresh before predicted bottleneck
After refresh, reset operations_since_refresh to 0 and update last_refresh_timestamp AND re-detect LLM capabilities

workflow_metrics.note: These metrics feed into self-improvement - track diligently

context_metadata.note: pwd should be verified before EVERY significant operation
